City bike stations

Demo Steward

Free bikes and free docks at every HSL city bike station, read from the helsinki project's shared stations.

This application has no endpoint for the shared city bike stations, so there is nothing to show. A steward of the project helsinki-mobility can check the shared space city-bikes.

Data: HSL city bikes (Inurba), ODbL 1.0, through the helsinki project of the joinedcontext platform.
